Hannes Küttner

Directus

@benhaynes  @hemendra\_khatik Monospace leaves your data where it lives naturally. We are not pulling any data at all, just making it available in a standardized API. When a request comes in to Monospace we plan the query across the individual data sources and serve it as a single result.   
  
That means we do allow you to create virtual relations between different data sources. You can have customer data live in one database and their orders in a separate database and still query it with a single request (or have your agent request it with a single MCP tool call) without additional round trips or N+1 queries.

@alchemist\_studio Great question! It's easy to mistake Monospace for one of the many tools out there that focusses on pulling a bunch of data to then visualize for business intelligence etc. Monospace focusses a lot more on helping you get the data to your own apps and agents and is therefore better compared to a Hasura or Supabase in terms of day-to-day usage, with our federated querying engine and management studio being the big differentiators 🚀
